ops.title: Codex recovery contracts and dispatch roster
ops.body:
Plan 486d766 remains executing. Orca runtime changed to a886d24c-cd90-4524-a375-362b11974353; old 11 dispatches failed terminal_missing at 04:42:56. Saved worktrees retain partial edits; /tmp artifacts lost. Accepted failure cleanup release all11, runtime reset Tasks ready so --retry-of refused and replacements started same tasks with explicit placements. All replacement turns observed. Recovery: prior dispatches failed after Orca runtime restart, all new workers started same saved worktrees. Your current uncommitted edits belong to prior implementation attempt; inspect and continue, do NOT discard/restart from origin or interpret them as unrelated edits. /tmp coordination/probe reports disappeared; recreate as needed. Current peers: hooks=dispatch:ctx_da23e1a2b87c; probe=dispatch:ctx_c1de20b5b616; monorepo=dispatch:ctx_8186adbc5231; standalones=dispatch:ctx_d65ca2b10aef; consumers=dispatch:ctx_db416e333e96; ccn=dispatch:ctx_d57de941e802; interact=dispatch:ctx_d47306fb6b7e; present=dispatch:ctx_011fb8b85d9b; ccx=dispatch:ctx_1c43034fadcd; fleet=dispatch:ctx_9d6b850d84e2; transcript=dispatch:ctx_30839957f146. Send direct peer contract messages where needed; coordinator owns integration decisions. Full approved plan remains cc-notes plan 486d766 in captain-hook. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 and GOMAXPROCS=4. Leave uncommitted, no global config/cache edits or live app restart. Don't stop for already approved routine contracts.

hooks: Contract accepted FileChange{path abs destination,old_path source,kind add/edit/delete/rename,old/new per-change string|null,content_scope file|fragment|unavailable}; FileRead path/start_line/end_line/complete only proven post delivery. ccx noticed shell_reads must exclude pipes/nesting/redirection and handle effective cd cwd before proving completion. CLI --host defaults Claude; hook --host codex run EVENT signed shim. Global captain-hook plugin sole dispatcher: discover neutral .capt-hook/hooks plus existing .claude/hooks roots, explicit --hooks overrides; do not add monorepo duplicate dispatch. CAPT_HOOK_HOOKS env was proposed but prefer automatic named neutral root for no shared-server env dependence. Stop/SubagentStop warn emits native systemMessage. ccn stages notices PostCompact drains PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit, include events. Need installed roster source, probe can assist. Cursor exact API coordinate transcript.

transcript: Approved cursor: TranscriptCursor().feed(new_bytes)->update with transcript immutable full snapshot, changed_from earliest revised/appended index (len events no change), committed_count newline-terminated physical rows. Provisional valid unfinished final JSON allowed; append revises. New cursor truncate/replace. Keep ActivityLift API; rebuild earlier changes. Native one physical row; execution projection dedup provider/thread/native call or item ID, completion-only native_input None; never parse arbitrary JS. ToolUse.origin provider/thread_id/turn_id/root_turn_id/call_id/native_name/native_namespace/native_input/origin row. Build wheel /tmp/codex-port-dist announce hooks.

interact: Publish exact API to consumers/present/fleet now. Prior agreed/on-disk ownership.Identity{Host,AccountHome,Endpoint,ThreadID}; Binding embeds +Generation int64,PID int,TerminalEnv map. subject.OwnedResolver{Store}.Find(ctx,binding,scope),.Start(ctx,binding,scope,slug,lifecycle,fresh) ->(Subject,bool,error). Upcoming codex.OpenRegistry,Registry.Binding/Register/WithBinding; Bridge{Registry,RPC,Binding,ToolName,Namespace}.Deliver(ctx,eventID,data),.Stream(ctx,consume.StreamSource). Shared integration MUST own daemon.Envelope ownership, HandlerCtx binding, cmd host flags/env capture. review TurnStore uses CloseOpenTurnsForWindow/LatestOpenTurn keyed ClaudePID: add thread ownership keyed methods to prevent two threads same server collision. cco stream fleet subject must include OriginAgent (ChannelCmd existing child filters unsuitable). Startup notification-only queue, authoritative endpoint/thread/account/generation not PID. Probe verifies MCP metadata. executable cc-codex shared launcher local only no live install.

fleet: Approved build/staging CLI python3 tools/codex_package.py build --output ABS_STAGE --artifact NAME=ABS_BUILT_BINARY [--source IDENTITY=ABS_ROOT]; output .agents/plugins/marketplace.json and self-contained plugins/IDENTIFIER. All edited local binaries must override release binrun pins. Native source manifests .codex-plugin/plugin.json with documented hooks/skills custom paths (plugin-creator validator stale). Global captain-hook sole lifecycle dispatcher, auto discover per-plugin pack.toml+hooks, no per-plugin capt-hook run. slop-cop standalone owns name slop-cop, report-only @skills uses slop-cop-report; gh-profile repo-summaries dependency included. codex-ask sync interact binding/bridge API. Publish source/artifact mapping for all peers.

ccx: Approved exec --host claude|codex default claude, CCX_HOST MCP launcher. Codex codex mcp list --json host/project/config-home cache, probe checks whether plugin servers included. You do not own plugin root roster API. FileRead contract hooks path abs, inclusive1-based extents/null, complete only successful full model delivery; unknown extents != complete. FileChange content_scope finalized. Prior worker already flagged pipes/nesting/redirection/effective cwd to hooks worker. Six reader procedures shared/native delegates.

ccn: Approved LookupEnv explicit CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID including empty wins, then CODEX_THREAD_ID before inherited CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID for CLI. MCP --host codex explicit --dir wins, host cwd ignore stale Claude project env, DO NOT trust process thread env until probe (shared appserver). Codex PostCompact restore using DeferredNotices drain PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit; global hooks wiring requested. run_cc_notes -R evt.cwd CODEX_THREAD_ID=evt.thread_id preserve explicit CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID. Fixtures need actual cwd; FileChange content_scope file|fragment|unavailable. Preserve full-image singular Claude comment-growth semantics; Codex fragments accurate.

present: Native Codex skills/manifests were on disk prior restart, baseline race/vet passed only before changes. Use interact ownership.Binding/OwnedResolver and Bridge, ask interact direct final signatures. ccx owns no plugin-root API: coordinate hooks effective roster. Monorepo needs supported host-neutral outcomes session selector for two skill call sites, send exact command. Installed plugin-creator validator stale rejects officially supported hooks/custom skills; validate runtime schema. Full active+idle feedback no fake user injection.

consumers: Own both cc-review checkout and existing /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-orchestrate/codex-orchestrate. Native roots plugin and plugins/cc-orchestrate respectively; override cc-review/bin/cc-review and cc-orchestrate/bin/cco. Prior race baseline passed cco with PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-orchestrate/.libghostty/ghostty-macos-arm64/share/pkgconfig. interact asked own Envelope/HandlerCtx/cmd host binding and thread-keyed TurnStore (old ClaudePID keys collide). Use explicit OwnedResolver binding. cco fleet stream includes OriginAgent. Directly sync interact now; no duplicate shared integration.

monorepo: Source origin/dev now SEVEN policies (not plan stale five): background-job-cleanup,commit-pr-template,pr-blocking-findings,pr-unpublished,rebase_on_dev_before_pr,slack_writes_need_permission,verify_push_before_reporting_done. Port/move all7 preserve identities, no invent repeated retry rule. Decision global captain-hook plugin sole dispatcher discovers .capt-hook/hooks plus existing .claude/hooks; moved hooks run once. Remove project duplicate capt-hook dispatch preserving unrelated settings/hooks. Explicit --hooks for tests. Keep .agents/skills source and .claude/skills symlink, no wholesale guides adoption or duplicate global plugins. Ask present exact host-neutral outcomes selector; warnings Stop native systemMessage now supported.

standalones: Own cc-guides plus standalone source overlays; previous /tmp/codex-standalone-sources may be lost, check then reacquire exact installed sources. Last status Datadog actual datadog-labs/claude-code-plugin rev6b8c62c; getaway had new JSONL agent-controller bridge and51 original tests passing but /tmp may be gone. wlm seven shared procedures respect configured Codex model and actual generator family. slop-cop standalone retains name slop-cop, @skills report name slop-cop-report. Fleet staging --source IDENTITY=ABS_ROOT, --artifact NAME=ABS_BUILT_BINARY. Package docs official custom hook/skills allowed despite stale validator. Need all remaining cc-guides/getaway/wlm/slop/revdiff/Datadog/claudish behaviors, report explicit display-transform limit.

probe: Read-only probe required before consumers finalize metadata. Temporary CODEX_HOME/fake MCP via appserver thread/start+mcpServer/tool/call, no real model turns/global changes/user-session injection. Determine per-thread stdio MCP process env/cwd versus per-call metadata, inspect CODEX_THREAD_ID availability and project cwd, codex mcp list --json includes plugin MCP servers? Also installed plugin roster canonical API/location helps hooks/present. Prior /tmp report lost. Relay evidence to coordinator and affected peers.
